text: Mohawk Industries Inc. (NYSE: MHK), the listed US parent of Unilin, is widely held: its 2026 proxy statement names as its only known holders of more than 5% of its common stock Jeffrey S. Lorberbaum (16.5% beneficially, including the 13.3% held by the family partnership Aladdin Partners, L.P.) and the asset managers BlackRock, Inc. (9.9%) and Dimensional Fund Advisors (5.1%); no state or state fund is listed.
short: Mohawk Industries 5%+ holders: Lorberbaum/Aladdin 16.5%, BlackRock 9.9%, Dimensional 5.1%.

source.name: Mohawk Industries, Inc. DEF 14A 2026 Proxy Statement (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: known by the Company to beneficially own more than five percent (5%) of the outstanding shares of the Common Stock
source.note: Stock Ownership Information table, beneficial ownership as of 27 March 2026: Jeffrey S. Lorberbaum 10,078,475 shares (16.5%), of which 8,132,685 (13.3%) are held by Aladdin Partners, L.P.; BlackRock, Inc. 6,071,097 (9.9%, Schedule 13G of 21 Jan 2026); Dimensional Fund Advisors LP 3,138,557 (5.1%).
